comment: Performance budgets of the samples (test/browser/perf.mjs, bench/README.md). One view per sample and quality tier, measured at a fixed drawing-buffer size. `ms` is the frame budget on the reference machine class; the score is 100 x the geometric mean of ms budget / measured ms over every pose of every view (100 = on budget on average, higher is faster). The other keys are ceilings that are reported when exceeded. Budgets are goals and change only by a decision of the owner, never to make a run pass.
